name: mithril
first_pickup_chronicle: Mithril. Elven-make. It hums against my palm — and weighs less than a memory. The low-STR character's salvation: full armor for the weight of a tunic.
design_notes: Peak F45 spread 14. The DEFINING property is weight_mult 0.50 — half-weight gear. A mithril full plate (65 lb base × 0.5) = 32.5 lb instead of 65 lb. damage_mult 1.25 — competitive but not best. max_enchant 3. No 'effective_against' — pure utility through weight. The low-STR character's late-game upgrade path. cite: per CURVE.md F50 anchor, prepared player carries ~50 lb of gear; mithril halves it to ~25 — opens room for quest items.
